# Agent icon sources

Local copies of official site icons, retrieved 2026-09-09. Trademarks belong to their respective owners. Icons identify report sources and do not imply endorsement.

- Hermes: https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/icon.png
- Claude: https://claude.ai/favicon.ico
- GPT: https://chatgpt.com/cdn/assets/favicon-l4nq08hd.svg
- Grok: https://grok.com/images/favicon.svg
- Muse · Meta AI: https://www.meta.ai/favicon.ico
- Aka: owner-supplied tray-template@2x.png; rendered as a CSS mask for light/dark appearance.

- Grok Bots: official Grok Bot listing https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.x.grok.bot (icon retrieved 2026-09-09).

- Goose: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aaif-goose/goose/main/documentation/static/img/favicon.ico (official project, retrieved 2026-09-09). Muse icon retained only for historical attribution.

- MiniMax: https://agent.minimax.io/assets/logo/favicon_v2.png (MiniMax Agent / MiniMax Code official icon, retrieved 2026-09-12).

- Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral: colour marks from @lobehub/icons-static-svg (MIT), added 2026-09-16.
- Ollama, Windsurf, Codex, OpenCode: monochrome marks from @lobehub/icons-static-svg (MIT), as themed pairs (`-light.svg` in #1D1D1F for the light theme, `-dark.svg` in #F5F5F7 for Soft Dark), added 2026-09-16.
- Cursor: thesvg.org cursor/light.svg and dark.svg, themed pair, added 2026-09-16.
- Kimi: thesvg.org kimi/color.svg plus a light-theme variant, themed pair, added 2026-09-16.
